title: Heterogeneous Trait Returns
goal: Return different types implementing the same trait from conditional branches.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: dyn Trait

hints: impl Trait requires every branch to yield the exact same concrete type at compile time.
Box<dyn Pet> converts both Dog and Cat into uniform heap pointers with vtables.
explanation: `impl Trait` requires a single concrete return type determined statically. Returning `Dog` in one branch and `Cat` in another causes `E0308` because they are distinct types. Wrapping both inside `Box<dyn Pet>` yields a uniform pointer type carrying dynamic dispatch tables. Returning bare `dyn Pet` causes `E0277` because trait objects are unsized and cannot be returned by value.
